概述

这是一个关于 【无情者】艾萨里昂 如何被转化为一名色孽爪牙的故事：无情者真的无情吗？又或者说，他只是一个被关在自己职责里的囚犯，需要被“解救”。

由于艾萨里昂所在的派系，与巫师系列有着联动内容，所以相关角色也无法幸免。主线故事将围绕着 艾萨里昂、卡维尔、梅林迪莱、特莉丝 进行展开。

在艾萨里昂雌堕并且被彻底腐化之后，色孽会给出一系列任务，让她抓捕世间那些正义的领主们。通过监牢里的审讯调教，最终将这些曾经的正义之士收入伊瑞斯派系。

Mod将包括新的任务，新的文本，新的模型，新的特性，新的个人技能线，新的监狱互动形式，以及和其他传奇领主的特殊互动故事。

计划之外：如果有思路的话，也会有新的腐化兵种。

阶段0——遭遇：（已基本完成）艾萨里昂在恶地征讨过程中，发现一个长时间里腐化那片土地的色孽恶魔——海珀诺赛丝，于是决定消灭这个恶魔，净化深植于土壤里污秽。但他最终失败了，被恶魔俘虏。

阶段1——囚犯：（制作中）艾萨里昂被关进自己的监牢，而恶魔则伪装成艾萨里昂摸样，统治伊瑞斯，将魔爪伸向艾萨里昂的亲信们。艾萨里昂对于秩序、正义的信念逐步被动摇。

English translation By translation software

The Stage0 content of the mod is basically completed, and the other parts are WIP

Overview

This is a story about how Eltharion [the Grim] was transformed into a Slaanesh general: Is The Grim really heartless? Or, he's just a prisoner in his own duties and needs to be "released".

Since Eltharion's faction has linkage content with the Witcher series, related characters cannot be spared. The main storyline will revolve around Eltharion, Cavill, Mellindirei, and Triss.

After Eltharion fell female and was completely corrupted, Slaanesh will give a series of missions to let her capture the righteous lords in the world. Through interrogation and corruption in the prison, these once righteous people were finally included in the Yvresse faction.

The mod will include new missions, new text, new models, new traits, new personal skill lines, new forms of prison interaction, and special interactive stories with other legendary lords.

Unplanned: If I have the spare time, there will be new Corrupted units too.

How to play

Stage 0: As soon as the new game starts, a mission will be released: Occupy gronti mingol. Following the entire quest process, you will eventually trigger a quest battle at the Dragon Horn Mine. Winning or losing will start the next stage, but if you win and complete the goals in the battle, you will get extra benefits, such as powerful campaign buffs (the specific benefits are under production)

Story spoiler

[[SPOILER]]

The story will be divided into 5 main stages:

Stage 0 —— Encounter: (Basically completed) Eltharion discovered a Slaanesh demon that had corrupted the land for a long time during his crusade in the badlands——Hypnosis. So it was decided to destroy this demon and purify the filth deeply rooted in the land. But he ultimately failed and was captured by demons.

Stage 1 —— The Prisoner: (WIP) Eltharion is imprisoned in his own prison, and the demon, disguised as Eltharion, rules over Yvresse, extending her claws to Eltharion's cronies. Eltharion's belief in order and justice was gradually shaken.

stage 2 —— Brainwashing: (WIP)

stage 3 —— Choice: (WIP)

stage 4 —— Rebirth: (WIP)
